name: smwpatches-item-box-disabled-on-death
title: Item Box Disabled on Death
description:
This patch fixes a glitch in the original SMW game. If Mario dies then it is still possible to drop the item in the item box by pressing Select. Thus losing your reserve item.

This patch checks if Mario is dying and disables the item box preventing the player from losing their reserve item.

Special thanks to yoshifanatic for some coding assistance.
